receipts.first_text_witness: You open Credit Karma on a Tuesday morning. Not because anything's wrong, just a quick check before work. You're expecting to see the 738 you had last month, maybe 740.
receipts.last_text_witness: If you found this useful, subscribe. I do this kind of breakdown every week and if this video just saved you from making one of these mistakes, drop it in the comments. I genuinely like hearing when this stuff actually helps someone.

primary_source_receipts.claim: Paying monthly, utilization and calculation timing
primary_source_receipts.finding: On-time monthly payment can help, but a high balance present when a score is calculated can affect the score even if paid in full the next day.

primary_source_receipts.claim: Counterintuitive FICO changes and reporting lag
primary_source_receipts.finding: The whole file determines the score; reported balances may differ from current balances; closing revolving accounts and paying off car loans can affect utilization or credit mix; score direction and magnitude are not fixed.
A lower limit may raise utilization, but the score may fall, rise or remain unchanged; closed accounts can remain and benefit history length for years.
Credit applications generally produce hard inquiries that can affect scores; prescreening, account review and self-review are soft inquiries and do not affect scores.

Negative account payment information is generally reportable for up to seven years; positive history may remain after payoff or closure. This current page does not validate selective retention after authorized-user removal.

primary_source_receipts.claim: FICO factor categories and model dependence
primary_source_receipts.finding: Documents the 35/30/15/10/10 factor categories and that bureau data can yield different scores. Percentages do not establish exact point changes from one action.

Among 1,001 participants, one in four identified possible errors that might affect scores, while about 5% had errors that could affect credit terms. The source does not support a current 40-million material-error count.
CFPB alleged faulty intake, failure to convey relevant dispute information and improper reinsertion. Allegations were not a final adjudication at video publication.
CFPB ordered a $15 million civil penalty for improper investigations of credit-reporting disputes.
FHFA approved FICO 10T and VantageScore 4.0 for future Enterprise use in 2022. The later implementation step occurred after the video's 2026-04-08 publication and is retrospective.

calculation_receipts.assumptions: Frozen views and age_days; nearest age-eligible same-channel long-form peers under build_baseline.compare; first five listed peers for sensitivity.

calculation_receipts.method: Standard fully amortizing fixed-rate mortgage principal-and-interest calculation
calculation_receipts.assumptions: $380,000 principal; 360 monthly payments; nominal annual rates divided by 12; no points, fees, taxes, insurance, prepayment or refinance.
